name: Load live trending titles and open a title
description: Verifies real catalog results appear in the streaming-style browse layout.
steps: Wait for trending titles to load
expected: A live TMDB title appears with its artwork and detail information.

name: Search the live catalog
description: Verifies search queries TMDB and shows matching or empty results.
steps: Search for a common movie title phrase
expected: Matching titles appear for the first search and a helpful empty state appears for the unmatched phrase.

name: Save and remove a title on mobile
description: Verifies a live title can be saved and removed from a narrow screen.
expected: The title appears in My List and disappears after removal.

name: Play a trailer or an authorized direct video
description: Verifies a TMDB trailer can play and the app accepts a direct video source.
steps: Open a title with a YouTube trailer
Enter and save an HTTPS video URL
expected: The trailer embeds in the detail view and an authorized direct video opens in the native player.

name: Show a useful catalog error and retry action
description: Verifies an upstream catalog failure is visible and recoverable.
steps: Open Northstar while the catalog request fails
expected: A clear catalog error and Retry action are visible.
